in_game_description: Very pretty sparkling crystals. When you look into them deeply, you feel like you can see the entire universe.
mechanics_text: Can only be obtained by mining asteroids in the Void system; Voids spawn indefinitely, making mining very dangerous.
Khador claims each crystal contains a tiny image of the universe, allowing the Voids to open wormholes anywhere.
After acquiring a Khador Drive, it is the only way to re-enter the Void system after finishing the base game.
One of the most expensive ores; tied with Novanium (in the Supernova campaign) for highest ore price.
